meta.how: subagent 不用任何工具，憑記憶作答

answers.pucker-effect-name: LiveEffect name "Adobe Pucker & Bloat" (escape as & in the XML); amount key "amount" (negative = pucker, positive = bloat), e.g. <LiveEffect name="Adobe Pucker & Bloat"><Dict data="R amount 50 "/></LiveEffect>
answers.zigzag-effect-keys: LiveEffect name "Adobe Zig Zag Filter"; ridges per segment key is "ridges" (others: amount, absoluteness/relAbs, smooth)
answers.blocked-menu-cmds: File > Save for Web (Legacy) and File > Package (both hang/loop on their dialog and cannot be completed from a script)
answers.repeat-config-null: Reading radialConfig / gridConfig / symmetryConfig on a Repeat item returns null/undefined (or throws) in 28.0, so you cannot read or modify the options through the DOM. The skill instead sets Repeat options through the menu commands (Object > Repeat > Radial/Grid/Mirror and Repeat Options) via executeMenuCommand, answering the Repeat Options dialog with its own dialog handler (filling the fields), then reads back the result.
answers.press-quality-bleed: The [Press Quality] preset has bleed 0 and does not use the document bleed, so the bleed is dropped (the PDF is cropped at the trim/artboard). To keep it set the bleed explicitly on PDFSaveOptions after choosing the preset: bleedLink = true (or use document bleed) and bleedOffsetRect = [bleed, bleed, bleed, bleed] (in points), optionally trimMarks = true.
answers.offset-path-effect-keys: "ofst" = offset distance, "jntp" = join type, "mlim" = miter limit
answers.point-area-route: app.executeMenuCommand('point-area') is refused / does nothing from a script (no conversion happens). The DOM equivalent is TextFrameItem.convertPointObjectToAreaObject() on the selected point text frame (and convertAreaObjectToPointObject() for the reverse).
answers.type-on-path-route: It runs it by recording/loading an action and playing it with app.doScript (action set loaded via app.loadAction from a generated .aia file), or by opening Type > Type on a Path > Type on a Path Options and answering that dialog with Effect = Skew using the skill's dialog handler.
answers.unverified-member-count: Guess: about 40 unverified members and about 60 COM-only members
answers.same-call-selection: Illustrator does not commit the new selection to the UI/menu-command context until the script yields or the document redraws, so executeMenuCommand in the same script still sees the old (or empty) selection. Fix: call app.redraw() after changing the selection and before executeMenuCommand, or split selection and the menu command into two separate run_js calls.
